note: Class C content (18, 4.5): the core never reads it. Catalogue of the Danish payment schemes the treasury and invoicing apps (22) need to know. Every fact names its basis: PBS = the PBS handbook for the FIK card +71< (August 2009, hosted by Danske Bank), DANSKE_FIK = Danske Bank terms for FIK (December 2002), NORDEA = Nordea Corporate Access Payables appendix Denmark (dated 2026-10-08, describes pain.001.001.03 codes), BS_RULES = Spar Nord general rules for debtors in Betalingsservice (effective 2019-09-14), PEPPOL = Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 Danish rules (read through a page fetch that summarises: not verbatim), NOT_READ = no source read. The bank documents are commercial usage guides, not law and not scheme rulebooks

core_home.core: extension attributes with is_pii on the partner bank account (22, 5.7)

facts.text: A payment service in Danish kroner. After a payment agreement the creditor can initiate the payment from the debtor account to the creditor account. Meant for periodic payments, one-off payments and, exceptionally, refunds
The debtor needs a connection agreement with the bank. Nets Denmark A/S provides the service
The debtor is paid out of on the payment day stated by the creditor on the payment overview, on bank days only

The debtor can reject an upcoming payment or request reversal of a completed payment at the latest on the 7th of the payment month. If that day is not a bank day the deadline is the next bank day. The reversal returns the amount from the creditor account
The debtor bank can reverse a payment, among other reasons when there are no funds on the payment day and the payment exceeds DKK 1,000, or when the debtor has no connection agreement

schemes.treasury_consequence: A Betalingsservice receipt is not final until the reversal window has passed (the 7th of the payment month). The collection app treats it as a payment that can come back as a returned payment (22, 5.6). Whether to post at the statement or after the window is an app policy
